profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Hit Promotional Products | Spring Boot, Java, Kotlin
profile.summary: Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience specialized in Android Mobile Development, crafting innovative, tailored solutions that meet ever-changing business requirements across diverse industries. A team player, with a fast-learning attitude, enthusiastic about solving complex problems, and driven to learn new technologies and processes. Committed to creating quality software with clean code and actively contributing to the success of the team and organization.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Developer:
* Created and maintained APIs with Spring Boot.
* Develop backend API for OrderYourImprint (https://orderyourimprint.com).
* Secure APIs with Spring Security and Auth0. Manage users, permissions and roles.
* Integrated third party services like ElasticSearch and ChatGpt to improve product search results.
* Implemented integrations with Blue Yonder WMS, Liftoff Commerce, Market Time with Restful WS to consume orders, update inventory and track shipments.
* CRUD operations on different SQL and No SQL dialects that includes MySql, Microsoft Sql Server and Mongo.
* Tested APIs with Postman, Mockito, JUnit and MockMvc.
* Handled tasks with Atlassian tools like Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket for sprint planning, code reviews, and deployments.
positions.insights: Spring Boot, Spring Framework and +16 skills

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
- Architected and designed applications using the MVVM pattern with Android Architecture Components, Data Binding and dependency injection using Hilt
- Created engaging UI using Jetpack Compose to provide more comprehensive and flattened UI hierarchies
- Applied Google Firebase tools like Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging (FCM) and Performance Monitoring
- Tested apps using different techniques along with JUnit, Mockito and Espresso.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed the Android apps with the MVP pattern.
- Applied Android Design Patterns to different form factor and screen density devices.
- Analyzed and created algorithms for effective and efficient technical solutions.
- Managed work with agile and SCRUM development techniques.
- Implemented push notifications with Google Firebase which increased usage of the app by 70%.
- Developed data communication using Retrofit over a RESTful Api.
- Trained other researchers to use the app to increase their performance and deliver results faster.

positions.title: Junior Application Developer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, Villa Clara, Cuba · On-site
positions.description:
- Developed a mobile application on Android 2.3+, using Android SDK and Android Studio
- Created a database to keep the data using a SQLite database
- Implemented the app to use Material Components suggested by Google
- Provided a map of the University that shows important places and the user’s location
- Used a third-party library to scan QR Codes
- Contributed to digitalization goals of the University, showing important information about historical places.

projects.title: Calculator app with CI/CD
projects.description: Simple Android app to demonstrate how set up CI/CD on mobile development with Bitrise. I learned how to integrate Firebase into a workflow for different purposes like deliver the app to different users like testers or managers. This set solid bases to automate any process like running the app’s tests, distributing it to a testing team, deploying it to Google Play and more.

projects.title: Calory Tracker multimodule app
projects.description:
Caroly Tracker app is built with Jetpack Compose UI toolkit. It uses libraries from Jetpack (like Hilt, ViewModels, Room, Navigation) and also other 3rd party libraries like Retrofit for network request, Coil to load images from the network, Mockk to mock classes and webservice when testing the app.

The app is a practical course from Philips Lackner. It teaches best practices and tricks to build complex applications like a multimodular app.
